sentences.en: These grapes are so sour that I can't eat them.
sentences.zh: 这些葡萄太酸了，我吃不下。

sentences.en: Criticisms that Japan's market is closed are just sour grapes.
sentences.zh: 批评日本市场封闭的说法只是出于嫉妒（酸葡萄心理）。

sentences.en: Grapes grow in thick clusters that are easy to pick.
sentences.zh: 葡萄生长成密集的簇状，很容易采摘。

senses.zh: 葡萄，葡萄藤，[色彩]深紫色，[军事]葡萄弹
